description:
Return the Combined Nomenclature sub-tree rooted at `customs_code`
(its sub-codes, and their sub-codes, ...), each with a `customs_code`
and a `text` description. Use this to see whether a heading you're
about to use (e.g. as `query.customs_code` elsewhere) is actually a
clean match, or bundles several distinct sub-codes together.

customs_code.description: Combined Nomenclature code to expand, e.g. '7010'.

lang.description: Language for translated labels in the response; any other language is refused.

name: get_subtree

customs_code.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

SubtreeNode.description:
One node of a CN sub-tree (recursive). The optional flags are sparse
on the wire: present when true (``siblings``: for catch-all nodes),
absent otherwise.

siblings.description: For a catch-all ('other') node, the ordinary siblings it excludes.

text.description: The code's label, in the requested language.

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

title: Get Subtree
